preReview.title: Noonan thrilled with Cincinnati's morale-boosting victory in MLS double-header
preReview.description: FC Cincinnati beat D.C. United 2-1 on Wednesday, and they are looking for a clean sweep when the sides meet again at Audi Field on Saturday.

preReview.title: Noonan, encantado con el triunfo de Cincinnati que refuerza la moral antes del segundo duelo de la MLS
